name: Dranik Sewers: Caverns of Exile
summary: A corrupted cavern network where exiled Dragorn spirits and Discord anomalies roam freely.
description: The Caverns of Exile form the deepest and most corrupted part of the Dranik Sewers. Once used as exile chambers for disgraced Dragorn, the caverns were overtaken by Discord energy and warped beyond recognition. Muramite forces avoid the area, leaving it to Discord manifestations, unstable arcane pockets, and tormented Dragorn spirits. The caverns are a chaotic labyrinth of broken stone, corrupted waterways, and arcane fissures. Only the most desperate resistance agents dare to enter.
